references.text: The tribe of Simeon is also mentioned in the census, where the representative of the tribe is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
The tribe of Simeon is mentioned again during the distribution of the land of Canaan, with another representative, Samuel son of Ammihud.
Simeon was Jacob's second son by Leah, and here the origin of his name is explained.
List of Simeon's sons who went to Egypt with Jacob, showing the tribe's origin.
